rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260)
rules.requirement: If you rent in a Jersey City building with 5 or more units, your rent may be regulated under the city's Rent Control Ordinance. You can ask the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations about your building's status through SeeClickFix or file an Illegal Rent Petition if you think your rent is illegal.

coverage.summary: Rental properties in Jersey City covered by the Rent Control Ordinance; all 1-4 unit properties are exempt. Other exemptions exist but are not listed on this page.

rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt; owners may submit a Rent Control Exemption Request if they meet other permitted exemption criteria, which this page does not list.
rules.quoted_span: Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control

notes: The city landing page only names the Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260) and the 1-4 unit exemption. It does not state the allowed increase formula, beyond linking a CPI chart, and does not list the other exemptions. The liability insurance requirement (N.J.S.A. 40A:10A-1) is outside the six categories, so it was not extracted.
